goal: Rust-own the final public attention-prefill family through its generic, static-heads8-online, and safe-SGEMM paths without claiming routed MoE, route-promotion, whole-archive policy, or C CUDA removal.

semantics: raw prefill rejects invalid public spans or windows above 256 before launch, and its generic zero-window path produces sink-only zero output while its optimized branches retain current-C full-causal zero-window behavior

static mixed prefill requires nonzero token count and ratio, supports zero window as full causal raw visibility, and selects generic, online, or cuBLAS paths with the current-C environment and quality priority
masked mixed prefill validates mask coverage, excludes the online path, and applies compressed-key additive masking in generic and cuBLAS branches

implementation.adapter_boundary: the public cuBLAS path preserves the proven cuda-oxide safe SGEMM adapter by packing query heads and replicating packed key/value rows per attention head
implementation.reuse_boundary: the public family reuses the measured M14.4d4 generic and M14.4d5 optimized kernel contracts, retained model-range resolution, and current-C dispatch selector
implementation.remaining_compute_boundary: all public attention ABI exports are Rust-owned; routed MoE, remaining graph compute, whole-archive retention policy, production route promotion, and C CUDA removal remain unowned
implementation.linkage_requirement: the C-linked proof retains Rust exports and embedded kernels with --whole-archive

integration_risks: raw zero-window behavior remains deliberately dispatch-sensitive because that is the present C contract: generic is sink-only while optimized branches are full causal
the prefill cuBLAS adapter deliberately replicates packed key/value rows for cuda-oxide safe SGEMM because the public wrapper does not expose current-C zero-stride batched GEMM directly
routed MoE, remaining graph compute, production route promotion, whole-archive retention policy, and C CUDA removal remain pending
the generated embedded CUDA object still emits an executable-stack linker warning during C-linked staticlib proof
